en-GB.label: English (UK)
en-GB.downloadBody: Save supported sources from the source picker. Download on desktop, or hand off to VLC on iPhone and iPad.
en-GB.intro: Take your existing ARVIO setup to Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad and smart-TV browsers. Your profiles, libraries, addons and progress stay connected through ARVIO Cloud.
en-GB.sync: Same profiles, libraries and watch progress
en-GB.free: Android & TV stay free. Self-hosting stays free.
en-GB.notice: ARVIO is a media hub for sources you configure. Catalog entries do not grant viewing rights. Connect only services and media you are authorized to use.
en-GB.trialEligibility: One free trial per ARVIO Cloud account.
en-GB.hosting: Live TV. Your favourite sources. Your ARVIO, in a browser. We handle the hosting — you enjoy the setup you already love.
en-GB.membershipTerms: Monthly membership. Cancel anytime through Ko-fi.
en-GB.coffee: Buy the developer a monthly coffee. Get ARVIO Web hosted 24/7 in return — no server to set up or maintain. Your support keeps ARVIO growing.
en-GB.tvBody: Bring your own IPTV service. Browse the programme guide and play supported channels right in ARVIO Web.
en-GB.libraryBody: Your watchlists, personal lists and watch progress — connected through ARVIO Cloud.
en-GB.serverBody: Bring your Jellyfin, Plex, Emby or Silo library into the same familiar interface.
en-GB.sportsBody: Explore sports events and find sources from your connected services.
